issue.title: Copy any link from a Markdown-born reference (Copy card L)
issue.description: While reading a bob-rendered report in Highlights, Command-Y L Return puts the URL of the link on the current page on the clipboard, exactly the URL the PDF opens. Option-Return copies it as a Markdown link, A copies every link, and `bob ref links` gives the CLI and agents the same data.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/ref_link_copy.md requests this work
